message: Docker on Windows Server 2025 via Rancher Desktop loses container state on restart. This will break your deployment. Switch to a Linux target, or disable Docker and use venv instead.
war_story: A production deployment, March 2026 — Docker stripped out on deadline day because containers would not survive restart on Server 2025. Cost half a day.

message: Electron apps run on the user's desktop, not inside a container. Docker is fine for development tooling or a separate server component (e.g. a web version or sync API), but the desktop app itself won't use it.
Electron apps don't sit behind a reverse proxy. Set Reverse Proxy to None.
Electron apps are single-user desktop installs. Set Multi-user to No.
The mobile app itself won't run in Docker. Docker is still a good fit for its API backend, which deploys separately.
Mobile apps don't use a reverse proxy. Set Reverse Proxy to None.
Authentik SSO runs its identity provider stack in Docker. Enable Docker or pick another auth method.
Authentik SSO requires a Linux target. Switch the target to Linux or pick another auth method.
SQLite is not suitable for multi-user SaaS. Concurrent writes will cause locking issues under real load. Use PostgreSQL.
war_story: SQLite write locking becomes a real problem the moment you have concurrent users. Fine for single-user internal tools. Not fine for anything multi-user in production.

message: No persistent storage needed. Database options are hidden.
Docker-only runtime requires Docker to be enabled.
Multi-user mode requires an authentication method. Select an auth option.
SaaS products need authentication. Without auth, you have no user isolation, no billing identity, no access control.
Reverse proxy options require Docker. Enable Docker or set Reverse Proxy to None.
PostgreSQL container will be auto-added to docker-compose.yml.
Redis is designed as a cache/queue add-on, not a primary database. Consider whether you actually need persistent storage first.
This is a throwaway prototype. Docker, PostgreSQL, and complex auth add overhead you probably don't need. Keep it simple.
You selected authentik SSO for a client deliverable. The client will need to run and maintain an authentik instance. Is that intentional?
CORS will be configured with explicit origins via .env variable. No wildcard * in production.
war_story: FastAPI default CORS config allows * origins. Fine for dev, dangerous in production.

message: shadcn/ui requires React. Switch frontend to React or disable shadcn/ui.
shadcn/ui requires Tailwind CSS. Switch styling to Tailwind or disable shadcn/ui.
Dev Containers require Docker.
